title: 301st Rescue Squadron at Invictus Games 2016
description: U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. August O'Niell, a pararescue specialist, and crew from the 301st Rescue Squadron, approach the landing zone in an HH-60G Pave Hawk during the Invictus Games 2016 opening ceremony at Discover Disney's ESPN Wide World of Sports in Orlando, Fla., May 8, 2016. O'Niell delivered the Invictus Games flag after hoisting down from the helicopter. (U.S. Army video by Pfc. Matthew J. DeVirgilio/Released)
